description.value:
“Who the fuck puts a scattergun barrel on a Burya? Techtronika did? Why? How do you even fire the damn thing without ripping an arm off? …Then again, an always-charged buckshot railgun is pretty nova. Fine, I’ll take two.”

Cost: 1,500eb (Very Expensive)

Class: Poor Quality Shotgun • Skill: Heavy Weapons • Range: N/A

Damage: N/A • Capacity: 3 (Shell Only) • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: Shotgun Shell (4d6)

Concealable: No

Slots: 1 • Attachments: Shotgun Rechamber, Sling, Tech Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: Can only load Shotgun Shells. Incompatible with Capacity modifying Attachments. This weapon’s Tech Rebuild can be charged without a Move Action. When fired by a user without BODY 11+ or paired Cyberarms, they suffer the Broken Arm Critical Injury if they didn’t have it already. Cannot be wielded in one hand by any means.

Range: N/A
Pre-installed: Shotgun Rechamber, Sling, Tech Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Shotgun Shell (4d6)

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
